summary.text: Four Clear Transforming Winds is Wu clan's immortal battlefield killer move. Wu Yong uses it as a clan trump card with four wind variations.

claims.text: After hiding in the field, Wu Yong drives an immortal battlefield killer move that raises fierce wind into formless pythons, then into wind blades that each carry rank eight piercing power and chase Feng Jiu Ge first. Destroyed blades turn back into wind and condense again in growing numbers. When Fang Yuan stays beside Feng Jiu Ge, reverse flow protection seal reflects blades into the battlefield rather than at Wu Yong, because Wu Yong is the hidden controller and not the direct attacker. The field next throws clear jade lightning that is dazzlingly fast, then clear jade dripping wind as green water-pearl drizzle, then profound immortal sound, which Fang Yuan judges the strongest of the four variation moves. Wu Yong names the battlefield four clear transforming winds: the four variations are clear wind blades, clear jade lightning, clear jade dripping wind, and profound immortal sound; a rank eight Wu clan ancestor created it and passed it down generation to generation, and with awe-inspiring might it helped Wu clan dominate Southern Border for countless years.

Feng Jiu Ge’s Separation Song makes the Gu worms that form four clear transforming winds separate and stop cooperating without destroying them, so the battlefield disintegrates. Wu Yong tries to abort too late, is forced out of hiding pale and staggering, and takes severe backlash because a destroyed immortal battlefield killer move hits its user hard, and this grand move’s power makes that backlash extreme.
Injury after the break and Wu Yong’s retreat.

With four clear transforming winds broken and Wu Yong heavily injured from the backlash, he still has Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building and can fight, yet he chooses a wise retreat once he finds Feng Jiu Ge can move and he can do nothing to Fang Yuan.
